description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandeveediya, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320053 (23/55031)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details for multiple properties. The content focuses on land title settlement and property registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
